title: ALMA Observations of a Candidate Molecular Outflow in an Obscured Quasar
question: What are the morphology, kinematics and mass of molecular gas in the obscured quasar SDSS J1356+1026, and is there a molecular outflow related to the known ionized outflow?

data.bands: CO(1-0) Band 3 (102.6 GHz sky); CO(3-2) Band 7 (307.9 GHz sky)

evidence.quote: data from Petric et al. in prep.

what.value: Ionized outflow properties (v~1000 km/s, t_dyn~1e7 yr, kinetic luminosity)

evidence.quote: A simple geometric model yields a deprojected velocity $v \approx 1000$ km s$^{-1}$

recipe.method: Moment-0 of line-free channels in 93/103 GHz spectral windows of CO(1-0) data
Aperture photometry (apertures ≥2x beam) on CO(3-2); CO(1-0) N/W blend separated via point-source beam fit in 100-500 km/s and assumed CO(3-2) spectral shape
key_parameters: Integration range -300 to 500 km/s (N, W); 300-500 (high-velocity); -80 to 50 (S)

recipe.goal: Derive molecular gas masses and SFR from CO
recipe.method: Mass from CO(1-0) luminosity with ULIRG XCO; SFR via Schmidt-Kennicutt law assuming 300 pc disk
assumptions: alpha_CO = 0.86 Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1, 0.5 dex error; outflow assumes L'(3-2)/L'(1-0)=1

recipe.goal: IR SED decomposition for SFR upper limit and Lbol
recipe.method: Two-temperature modified blackbody fit to seven points; Tcold fixed 35 K, beta=1.5, 10% errors; Bell 2003 calibration for SFR
2-D Gaussian fit per channel, linear fit of position vs velocity for PA, pv-diagram of width 0.5" along PA
r=0.3 kpc, v=500 km/s, M=7e7; Mdot=3Mv/r for volume-filling outflow

evidence.quote: the molecular gas mass is estimated to be $3^{+6}_{-2} \times10^8$ $M_{\odot}$
the W arm contains $5^{+11}_{-3} \times10^8$ $M_{\odot}$  of molecular gas

evidence.loc: 5.2.2 AGN or Star Formation Driven Outflow?

answer_key.quantity: SFR upper limit from FIR SED

evidence.quote: upper limit on the star formation rate of 21 $M_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$
The best-fit temperature of the warm component is high $T_{\rm{warm}}=81$ K
best-fit gradient of 1077 km s$^{-1}$ kpc$^{-1}$

not_stated_but_needed: Exact clean parameters (cell size, image size, niter, masks, spectral-line channel ranges for CO 3-2)
Line-free channel ranges for CO(3-2) 300 GHz continuum check
Kinematic fitting details of 2D Gaussian per channel
Herschel photometry values (Petric et al. in prep.)
Exact formulae for outflow energetics and Kennicutt SFR conversion
missing_for_reproduction: Cell/image size and clean iteration settings
score_reason: Data are well specified and key settings (robust, velocity ranges) given, but several imaging and photometry details and Herschel data are missing.
rediscovery_reason: ALMA project codes are given, recipe mostly complete, and results (fluxes, masses) are numeric.
